title: Removal of the Cabin Floor Proximity Escape Path Marking
abstract: Removal of the floor proximity escape path marking along both aisles and around the exits, with the emergency lighting system de-energised and the distributed batteries isolated.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the cabin floor proximity escape path marking for replacement, for access to the seat track cover line or for a cabin reconfiguration.
sections.job_setup_note: De-energise the emergency lighting system and isolate the distributed battery units before any marking is disturbed. On aircraft with the light-emitting diode standard the strip stays live from its local battery even with the aircraft unpowered, which is the reason for the isolation step. Lift the aisle carpet only as far as the work needs; a fully lifted carpet is difficult to lay back without creasing.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the cabin seats along both aisles as far as the work needs. 2. De-energise the emergency lighting system at the maintenance panel. WARNING: ISOLATE THE DISTRIBUTED BATTERY UNITS BEFORE YOU TOUCH THE MARKING STRIP. THE STRIP STAYS LIVE WITH THE AIRCRAFT UNPOWERED. 3. Lift the aisle carpet in zones 291 and 951 as far as the work needs. 4. Disconnect the strip at each cabin station and put a protective cap on the connector. 5. Remove the exit marker assembly D3320137300785 at each exit. 6. Release the strip from the seat track cover line, working forward to aft. CAUTION: DO NOT PULL THE STRIP OFF THE CHANNEL. THE CHANNEL LIP IS THIN AND WILL BREAK, AND THE LINING PANEL IS THEN NOT REUSABLE. 7. Remove the tubular spacers AES27771-7A and keep them if they are to be used again. 8. Remove the lining panel D3320007009192 where the work needs it. 9. Remove the lens from the exit panel 841LP7 and from the inboard stowage marker 850LP6. 10. Clean the channel and do a general visual inspection of the seat track cover line.
sections.close_out: Identify the removed items by position. Keep the emergency lighting system de-energised and the batteries isolated until the marking is installed again. Record the channel condition on the aircraft work card and report any broken channel lip before the replacement strip is ordered. Make sure that the aircraft is not released to service with the emergency lighting inoperative.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Pre MOD-163890 aircraft carry the powered incandescent strip; post MOD-164122 aircraft carry the light-emitting diode strip with local batteries.

safety_precautions: De-energise the emergency lighting system at the maintenance panel.
Isolate the distributed battery units before touching the strip.
Do not release the aircraft with the emergency lighting inoperative.
